name: Culm
author: Erin Carter
description: A sparse grove of thick bamboo canes, near-black at rest. Gust fronts cross the grove cane by cane, and each struck cane answers from the ground up: a sparkle of node-ring glints climbs joint by joint to the leafy tip while the stiff top bows with an elastic overshoot, so light travels up the plant rather than across the field.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often gust fronts move through the grove.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How far the canes tip and how brightly the climbing glint-run registers at each joint.

params.label: Cane spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between the thick canes, holding the grove at roughly six to ten visible culms.

params.label: Node glow
params.effect: Brightness of the node-ring glints as the sparkle climbs each cane.
